verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Adyen supports integration across web, iOS, Android, React Native, and Flutter platforms, implying official client/server SDKs exist, and documents concrete API request flows (Checkout sessions, /paymentMethods, /payments) that SDKs would wrap. However, there is no explicit documentation of a language/platform SDK catalog, versioning, or SDK-specific developer experience — missing for 10: explicit SDK list/repos, SDK documentation pages, code examples using SDKs, independent developer confirmation of SDK quality.
